subject: planner: support creating universal bindings from historical plans (#49765)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (d844553c..) focusing on planner changes in `pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go` around `buildCreateBindPlanFromPlanDigest`. The change mirrors existing manual-binding behavior: for `IsUniversal` it restores SQL via `utilparser.RestoreWithoutDB`, clears `Db`, and propagates `IsUniversal` into `SQLBindPlan`, producing normalized SQL/digest without schema so bindings can match across databases. Cross-checked surrounding bind SQL generation (`bindinfo.GenerateBindSQL`) and binding normalization/matching path (`pkg/planner/optimize.go`), plus the added test that exercises universal bindings-from-history semantics. No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, privilege boundaries, session/transaction behavior, or compatibility for the planner behavior introduced here.
